arms.O0: reuse D0 receipts, or same C4 fresh control
arms.O1: reuse D1 receipts, or same D1 fresh control
arms.O2: wave metadata with explicit independent evidence need
arms.A0: standard catalog and native delivery tools
arms.A1: same catalog and native delivery plus wave_query

continuous_video_semantics: unverified; projected I/R, movement and similarity are navigation only.

o_policy.scope: late only = final third; otherwise full video

controls: One real count-only full and publicly scoped uniform PTS stream per completed O2/O3. Same-input clean sessions per A0/A1 and counterbalanced launch order. No fixed image/window count or weights.
routing: Native SDK and per-session read-only MCP tools preferred. If MCP image transport fails after a provider-successful probe, the same model may actively request the same named actions over SDK host dispatch; audit the actual implementation explicitly. No alternate model or provider.
separation: Metadata queries cannot emit images or receipts. delivery_request handles exact originals solely after a declared goal-relevant reason. No E0 or hidden source naming in DSH. Scoring separately assesses image reach and meanings in cited image observations. Tool input schemas and model settings the same except navigation availability.
technical_stop: A worker has a transport watchdog measured in wall seconds, not visits, windows or images. Record aborts, never count pending pre-consumption outputs. Offline cue investigations naturally end when independently declared observation needs have been examined. No candidate deletion.
